close_reason: properties parsed in handle_get and passed to get_objects
description:
## Why this issue exists

RFC 8620 §5.1 requires /get to honour the client's 'properties' field — the list of object
fields requested. handle_get in handlers.rs hardcodes None as the properties argument to
backend.get_objects, discarding whatever the client sent. Every /get handler that delegates
to handle_get (Thread, Email, Mailbox, Chat, Space, Message, etc.) silently ignores property
selection.

Tracked as JMAP-4ii.6. Currently deferred because fixing it requires API work.

## What needs to happen

1. Add a Property associated type to JmapObject (or GetObject) in jmap-server/backend.rs:
     type Property: for<'de> serde::Deserialize<'de> + Send + Sync;
   This lets handle_get deserialize ["id", "subject"] into Vec<O::Property> generically.

2. In handle_get, after parsing ids, also parse the 'properties' field:
     let props: Option<Vec<O::Property>> = match args.remove("properties").unwrap_or(Null) {
         Null => None,
         v => Some(serde_json::from_value(v)
                   .map_err(|_| JmapError::invalid_arguments("properties must be a string array"))?),
     };
   Pass props.as_deref() as the third argument to get_objects.

3. Each concrete object type (Email, Mailbox, Thread, Chat, Space, Message, etc.) must define
   its Property enum with serde string deserialization matching the RFC wire names.

4. Domain /get handlers that do NOT use generic handle_get (e.g. handle_chat_get, handle_email_get)
   must be updated to do the same parsing and pass the slice through.

5. The MemoryBackend implementations in tests/common/mod.rs must respect the properties slice
   (or at minimum accept it without panic — ignoring it is acceptable for a test backend).

## Acceptance criteria

- cargo test --workspace passes
- A /get call with properties=["id"] does not cause get_objects to be called with None
- The backend receives Some(&[...]) when properties is present, None when absent or null
- Existing tests that do not send 'properties' continue to pass unchanged
title: handle_get: parse and pass 'properties' field to backend (RFC 8620 §5.1)
